chapters.title: Open the live board — just read, no editing
chapters.subtitle: Do not click Manage / Record Work. Scan top → bottom in about 2 minutes.

chapters.title: 1 · Current Bandwidth
chapters.subtitle: Available, Focused, or Fire drill — know capacity before asking for more work.

chapters.title: 2 · Workload Split Bar
chapters.subtitle: See how active work is split across Boss A / B / C. You share this bandwidth.

chapters.title: 3 · Filter by your name
chapters.subtitle: Optional: click your boss tab to hide other teams and see only your requests.

chapters.title: 4 · Doing Right Now
chapters.subtitle: Active focus today — kept to 1–2 items so delivery finishes faster.

chapters.title: 5 · Read one work card
chapters.subtitle: Boss tag · Priority · Mini progress · Title · ETA. One glance = full status.

chapters.title: 6 · Blocked / Waiting
chapters.subtitle: Paused for access, decision, or reply. If it is you — answer to unblock.

chapters.title: 7 · Up Next (#1 is next)
chapters.subtitle: Need yours sooner? Ask to swap with #1 — not “are you free?”

chapters.title: 8 · Future Vault, then Recently Completed
chapters.subtitle: Long-term work has a date and alarm. The Done row is proof it was delivered.
